ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

2. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   B. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   C. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

12. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   D. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in His and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
